name: SCGBHD
recent: Southern Cable 近期持续出现雇员公积金局 (EPF) 的股权变动申报，同时公司私下配售最多 10% 新股的计划已于 2026 年 10 月 19 日完成（剩余部分不再进行）。此外，凭单转换持续进行，公司股本有所增加。
notable: 私下配售最多 10% 新股计划完成，截至 2026 年 10 月 19 日共发行 102,378,500 股配售股，剩余配售股不再进行。
凭单转换持续进行，分别于 2026 年 10 月 13 日、10 月 27 日及 11 月 11 日有新股上市。
risks: 私下配售发行新股可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
EPF 近期多次申报股权变动，显示大股东持股出现变化。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 527.6 million，环比增长 21.9%，同比增长 25.8%；净利为 MYR 40.6 million，环比增长 22.3%，同比增长 28.2%；净利率为 7.7%，与上季持平。

recent_en: Southern Cable has seen continuous EPF shareholding change filings recently, while its private placement of up to 10% new shares was completed on 19 October 2026 (remaining portion not proceeded with). Warrant conversions also continued, increasing the company's share capital.
notable_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares was completed, with 102,378,500 placement shares issued as at 19 October 2026; the remaining placement shares will not be proceeded with.
Warrant conversions continued, with new shares listed on 13 October, 27 October and 11 November 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
EPF has filed multiple shareholding change notices recently, indicating changes in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 527.6 million, up 21.9% QoQ and 25.8% YoY; net income was MYR 40.6 million, up 22.3% QoQ and 28.2% YoY; net margin was 7.7%, unchanged from the previous quarter.
